Version: 2026-09-29. These terms govern the basic conditions for using Tailmance. Any country- or region-specific terms shown to you also form part of the agreement. The account holder must be at least 18 years old.
1. Service and account

Tailmance is a platform that helps cat and dog owners create pet profiles and use eligible features for discovery and social interaction. You must keep your account information accurate, protect your account, and must not transfer it to another person. Tailmance is not a medical, emergency, animal-sales, or payment-intermediation service.
2. Age and eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. If applicable law or store rules require additional age assurance, further verification may be required before access to the service. A false age statement may result in restricted or terminated account access.
3. Pet profiles and user responsibility

You may upload only pet, photo, health, and profile information that you are authorized to use and share. You must not knowingly misrepresent health, vaccination, breed, age, sex, or ownership information. Do not upload unnecessary personal or sensitive information about other people.
4. User content and license

You retain your rights in content you upload. You grant Tailmance a worldwide, non-exclusive license limited to operating the service, storing the content, displaying it to you and users you choose, providing safety and moderation, and technically transmitting it. 5. Prohibited content and conduct

Animal harm or abuse; harassment, threats, or hate; child sexual abuse material; fraud; illegal goods or services; unauthorized sharing of personal data or intimate images; false health or verification information; intellectual-property infringement; impersonation; bypassing security or moderation measures; and facilitating illegal activity are prohibited. See the [Community Guidelines](community-guidelines.html) for details.
6. Animal sales, commercial breeding, and mating

Tailmance is not a pet marketplace, animal-sales platform, or breeder marketplace. The platform may not be used to offer prices, payments, deposits, sales, or delivery of animals; acquire customers for commercial breeding; or facilitate unlawful breeding or animal trafficking. The mating feature is disabled by default and may be used only if Tailmance explicitly enables it and applicable law and animal-welfare rules permit it.

Tailmance may limit content visibility or account access for safety, these terms, the Community Guidelines, or legal obligations. Where appropriate, a reason and an available appeal path are provided. A successful appeal does not automatically remove another independent and valid restriction on the same content or account. See [Moderation Decisions and Appeals](moderation-appeals.html).
8. Animal health and emergencies

Tailmance does not provide medical care, diagnosis, or emergency services. Vaccination, health, or verification records in the app do not replace a professional assessment. In a health or safety emergency, contact an appropriate emergency service or competent authority.
9. Premium and store billing

Premium is optional; Standard use continues without a subscription. Unless the store states otherwise, Premium is an auto-renewing subscription. The binding price, currency, tax, billing period, and any trial or promotion terms are shown on the App Store or Google Play purchase screen. The subscription is managed and cancelled through the relevant store account. Deleting your Tailmance account does not automatically cancel the store subscription. See [Subscription and Consumer Information](subscription-consumer.html).

The [Privacy Policy](privacy.html) and, for Türkiye, the [KVKK Notice](kvkk.html) explain data processing. Consent to marketing push notifications is separate and optional. If an age-assurance service processes identification, face images, biometric data, or other sensitive data, you will receive the relevant additional privacy information and rights.

You can permanently delete your account; if you cannot access the app, you can submit a [web deletion request](delete-account.html). Features may change, be suspended, or be unavailable in a country for security, legal, store-policy, or product-development reasons. 14. Liability and non-waivable rights

Nothing in these terms removes any consumer, data-protection, accessibility, or other right that applicable law does not permit you to waive. Warranty disclaimers or limitations of liability apply only to the extent permitted by applicable law.
15. Governing law and local terms

Privacy Policy

Version: 2026-09-29. Data controller: Yekta Özel. This policy explains how personal data is processed in connection with Tailmance. Any country- or region-specific privacy supplements shown to you apply together with this policy. This policy is not consent to marketing.
1. Categories of data we process
Account and session data: user identifier, email address, email-verification status, session data, and account status.
Security and technical data: IP and device/network context, timestamps, security events, rate-limit and abuse-prevention records, push-notification token, and app/operating-system information.
Pet and social-use data: cat/dog profiles, photos, social content, messages, matches, meetup/event information, and interaction data.

Location: when you permit it, device location may be used for discovery. Tailmance rounds coordinates to three decimal places before sending them to the server, stores them privately, and does not show the coordinates themselves to other users; only approximate distance is displayed.
Health and verification data: vaccination and health records that you choose to upload. Do not include unnecessary third-party personal data in those documents.
Subscription data: store subscription status and transaction references. Tailmance does not directly collect your payment-card number.
Safety and moderation data: reports, blocks, moderation decisions, appeals, and related review information.
Notification and marketing preferences: service-notification preferences and, only if you separately choose it, records of consent to marketing push notifications.
Legal-context records: records showing which legal documents were presented to you in which country, region, and document-language context, and the choices you made.
2. Sources of data

We may obtain data directly from you, your device and app use, content you upload, safety and moderation processes, stores such as the App Store or Google Play, and authorized service providers used to operate the service. Limited information about you may also arise from another user’s report or content.
3. Purposes of processing

Data may be processed to provide accounts and social features; enable discovery and matching; deliver communications and notifications; protect security; prevent fraud and abuse; manage content moderation and appeals; verify subscription status; respond to user requests; perform data export and account deletion; maintain service reliability; and comply with applicable legal obligations.
4. Legal bases and local differences

Depending on the processing, we may rely on entering into or performing a contract, compliance with a legal obligation, legitimate interests, consent, or another basis recognized by applicable law. The applicable basis may differ by purpose, data category, and country or region. Local privacy supplements shown to you explain those differences.
5. Privacy notices and marketing consent are separate

This policy and similar notices are provided for information. They are not consent to every processing activity. Where consent is required, it is requested separately for the specific purpose. Consent to marketing push notifications is optional and may be withdrawn in Settings without disabling service notifications that are necessary to operate the account.
6. Location data

Tailmance requests only the level of location permission needed for the feature being used. For discovery, the app rounds device coordinates to three decimal places on the client before transmission, stores those rounded coordinates privately, and exposes only approximate distance to other users. Location permission may be withdrawn through device settings, although location-dependent features may then stop working.
7. Health and other potentially sensitive data

Pet vaccination, health, and verification documents can contain sensitive or third-party information. Upload only what is necessary and what you are authorized to provide. If age assurance or another legally required process uses identity, face, biometric, or similarly sensitive data, you will receive additional information on the provider, purpose, legal basis, retention, transfers, alternatives, and rights before such processing is enabled. Tailmance evidence tables are designed not to store raw identity-document or face images.
8. Sharing and service providers

We may share data only as needed with authorized infrastructure, security, moderation, communications, subscription, analytics/crash, or support providers; with stores such as Apple or Google for subscription-related functions; with other users where a feature requires sharing; or with competent authorities where lawfully required. Service-provider access is limited to the relevant purpose and contractual or legal safeguards.
9. International transfers

Data may be processed outside the country where you live. Where transfer restrictions apply, we use an applicable transfer mechanism or other required safeguard and provide country-specific information where necessary. A generic statement about international transfers does not replace any local notification, filing, or transfer requirement that applies to a particular market.
10. Retention

We retain personal data only for as long as needed for the stated purpose or required by applicable law. Different data categories may have different retention periods. After the relevant period, data is deleted, destroyed, anonymized, or otherwise handled as required by applicable law. Account deletion may not immediately erase limited security, fraud-prevention, dispute, accounting, preservation, or legal-request records that law requires us to retain.
11. Security

We use technical and organizational safeguards appropriate to the nature of the service, including access controls, server-side authorization, protected storage, rate limiting, security logging, and restricted administrative operations. No system can guarantee absolute security. If a breach triggers a legal notification duty, the applicable regulator and affected persons will be notified in accordance with the relevant law.
12. Your rights and choices

Depending on applicable law, you may have rights to access, obtain a copy of, correct, delete, restrict, or object to processing; withdraw consent; portability; information about recipients or transfers; appeal certain automated or moderation decisions; and complain to a regulator or court. You can use in-app account export and deletion tools where available or the [web deletion request](delete-account.html) if you cannot access the app. Local supplements explain additional rights and procedures.
13. Children and age assurance

Tailmance accounts are for people aged 18 or older. The 18+ product rule does not by itself replace any age-assurance, child-safety, or platform duty that applies in a particular jurisdiction or store. Where additional age assurance is required, the method must be proportionate and privacy-conscious, and information about false-reject alternatives, review, and redress will be provided where applicable.
14. Marketing communications

Marketing push notifications are disabled unless you separately opt in. You may withdraw that choice in Settings. A push-consent choice does not automatically authorize email, SMS, telephone, or other marketing channels. Channel-specific regimes, such as Türkiye’s commercial electronic-message rules or comparable local regimes, are handled separately where applicable.
15. Representatives and local contacts

Where applicable, country- or region-specific requirements for a privacy, digital-services, or other legal representative are assessed separately. Required representative, regulator, operator, or consumer-contact details are included in the country-specific supplement presented to you.
16. Changes

We may update this policy. For material changes, notice or renewed consent/preference will be requested where required by applicable law. Choices made in a previous country or document-language context do not automatically carry over to a new legal context.

Community Guidelines
These rules are designed to keep Tailmance safe for people and animals. They supplement the Terms of Use and any local legal terms shown to you.
Pet safety and animal welfare
Do not promote animal harm, neglect, cruelty, animal fighting, dangerous challenges, or harmful care or breeding practices.
Do not treat a match, user statement, or health badge in the app as a substitute for professional assessment when professional care is needed.
Plan meetups in safe, pet-appropriate environments. In an urgent health or safety situation, contact an appropriate emergency or competent service.
Animal sales and commercial breeding are prohibited

Tailmance is not a pet marketplace, animal-sales platform, or breeder marketplace. Do not offer prices, payments, deposits, sales, delivery, or commercial-sale listings for animals. Do not use the platform for unlawful breeding, high-volume harmful breeding, animal trafficking, regulated-wildlife trade, or acquiring customers for commercial breeding. Do not use mating features unless Tailmance explicitly makes them available in your context and applicable law and animal-welfare rules permit the use.
Respectful and safe communication
Harassment, threats, blackmail, hate speech, sexual harassment, and persistent unwanted contact are prohibited.
Do not create new accounts or pet profiles to bypass a block, restriction, or moderation decision.
Do not share another person’s private address, phone number, identity information, financial information, precise location, or intimate images without authorization.
Do not engage in fraud, phishing, fake giveaways or assistance, impersonation, or account-takeover attempts.
Child safety and serious illegal content

Child sexual abuse material, grooming or luring a child for sexual purposes, or content that promotes sexual exploitation of children is strictly prohibited. Do not post or promote serious and imminent threats to life or physical safety. When such content is reported, it may be removed or restricted; records may be preserved and reports may be made to competent authorities where applicable law requires. Nothing in these rules limits mandatory reporting, preservation, emergency, or law-enforcement obligations.
Authentic and trustworthy profiles
Do not use a photo that is not of your pet or an unauthorized health document.
Do not knowingly misrepresent breed, age, sex, health, ownership, or verification information.
Do not add unnecessary personal data about other people to profiles, documents, messages, or content.
Do not falsely present yourself as a health professional or make misleading diagnosis or treatment claims.
Content and platform integrity

Do not publish content that infringes another person’s copyright, trademark, or other intellectual-property right. Do not use malicious code, spam, unauthorized automated collection, bots, or tools designed to bypass security or moderation. Do not facilitate illegal goods or services, controlled substances, weapons, human or animal trafficking, or other criminal activity.
Reporting, blocking, and appeals
You can report suspicious content in the app, block interactions, and remove a match. For eligible moderation decisions affecting you, Tailmance provides a reason and an available appeal path.
Intellectual-property notices
Rights holders may use the [Intellectual Property Notices](intellectual-property.html) process. Repeated and verified infringement may lead to proportionate content or account restrictions.
Contact
Use the channels on the [Support](support.html) page for safety and support.

The subscription is managed and cancelled through your App Store or Google Play account. Deleting your Tailmance account does not automatically cancel the store subscription. If you want to stop future store charges, cancel the subscription separately in your store account.

Moderation Decisions and Appeals
Tailmance may take proportionate moderation action to protect users, animals, platform integrity, and legal compliance. Eligible decisions include a reason and an available appeal route.
Types of measures

Depending on the issue, Tailmance may limit visibility, remove or disable content, restrict a feature, pause or restrict an account, block a transaction or interaction, or take another proportionate safety measure.
Reasons and evidence

Where appropriate and legally permitted, we provide the main reason for the decision and enough information for you to understand what was affected. We may withhold details where disclosure would undermine safety, reveal confidential abuse-detection methods, prejudice another person’s rights, or be prohibited by law.
Appeal

If an appeal is available, use the in-app appeal route or the channel shown with the decision. Provide relevant context and do not submit unnecessary sensitive information. An appeal is reviewed using the applicable policy and evidence.
Outcome and restoration

If an appeal is accepted, the affected state is restored only to the extent no other independent and valid restriction applies. Except where disclosure is prohibited for safety or legal reasons, an appropriate explanation and any further available route are shown.

This internal appeal process does not remove any right under applicable law to contact a regulator, court, dispute-resolution body, or other competent authority.
